text: Kyndra Swiftarrow is a human located at the archery range in New Avalon in the . She oversees training of the nearby s.
Kyltus Bloodburn is a blood elf located on Sunstrider Isle in Eversong Woods.
Kylia Solguard is a blood elf located in Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods.

Lady Vinazian is a nerubian sage found in the Weaver's Lair in Azj-Kahet. She acts as the quartermaster for the Severed Threads, and each week she offers a choice of Pact with Widow Arak'nai the Weaver, Anub'azal the General, or Executor Nizrek the Vizier. She took over as quartermaster for the Severed Threads after Y'tekhi was compromised by Xal'atath.

Laenia Sunshimmer was a blood elf who was slain when the Twilight's Blade attacked her family's farm in Eversong Woods. Believing the Amani trolls in Zul'Aman were to blame, her brother headed to Zul'Aman to try and avenge her.
Landan is a human located at Gilded Oaks in Founder's Point.
Larandel Dawnhaze is a void elf found sitting next to Maxwell Saltsong on an unnamed isle northwest of the Waking Shores.
Latent Wisdom is a Farseer hero talent for shaman. It is an exclusive choice node with Ancient Fellowship.
Larsera is a green dragon located in Forest Song in during Nightmare Incursions.
Lazaar Baneshadow is a blood elf who transforms himself into a lich in the Ruins of Deatholme in Eversong Woods. He spawns during Void Assaults.
Leariah Nightspear is a void elf found sitting on a bench in central Valdrakken during Who Are You?.
Leogan was a human found in . He was replaced by Caldoran during the PTR, but is referenced by the item Leogan.
Leona Darkstrider is a void elf and the first of the ren'dorei demon hunters.
Lensholvada is a night elf located at Brumewood Hollow in Founder's Point.
Leoron Summersong is a blood elf located in Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods.
Lethal Reflexes is a Slayer hero talent for warriors. It is an exclusive choice node with Opportunist.
Lethal Preservation is a Wildstalker hero talent for druids.
Let Terror Reign is a Rider of the Apocalypse death knight hero talent.

Lidamorrutu is an infinite dragon vendor located at Infinite Bazaars during Pandaria Remix. She also sells replacement accessories to players who have earned the related achievements. During Legion Remix, she starts Make Haste, Not Waste each day, awarding a cache of Precious Jewelry each day.
Leysight is an Arcane mage talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Aether Fragment.
Lieutenant Blazewing is a blood elf farstrider and a target of Prey hunts.
Lifecinders is a Flameshaper hero talent for evokers. It is an exclusive choice node with Draconic Instincts.
Lieutenant Gom'tok is a fel lord found in Ulduar during Ulduar's Oath.
Lieutenant Saranelle is a blood elf located in Farstrider Hold in Eversong Woods.
Lieutenant Valria is a blood elf located at Lightbloom Lash'Ra in Eversong Woods.
Lightless Scavenger's Necessities is the tier 32 hunter set.
Lil' Manny is a pit lord companion that currently isn't available to players. He's named after the not-so-lil' Mannoroth.
Lil' Coalee is a pit lord companion given as a reward to viewers of eligible Twitch streams who watched for at least four hours from 1 October to 29 October 2025.
Lil' Ashlee is a pit lord companion obtainable by purchasing a Warcraft merchandise from the "Lil' Ashlee collection" on the Blizzard Gear Store between 21 November and 8 December 2025.
Lilatha is a blood elf ranger of the Farstriders. First appearing as Ranger Lilatha in , she has been promoted to Ranger Captain Lilatha in .
Lingering Radiance is a Herald of the Sun paladin hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Blessing of An'she.
Lingering Darkness is a Deathstalker rogue hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Symbolic Victory.
Lingering Phantom's Encasement is the Tier 30 death knight set.
Lilaju is a forest troll child and leader of the Revantusk tribe located in Zul'Aman.
Limien Bountcask is a blood elf vendor located at Goldenmist Village in Eversong Woods.
Lord Harlbrand is a human planned to appear in the Arathi Highlands during the Plunderstorm.

Lord Antenorian was a blood elf and the governor of Tranquillien in Eversong Woods. He was later revealed to be a member of the Twilight's Blade and a follower of Xal'atath, who ultimately betrayed him after his failure to conquer Tranquillien for the Devouring Host. He was seemingly killed by Valeera Sanguinar and the adventurers in the Shadow Enclave, but barely survived as a voidling. Antenorian eventually reconstituted his body, but was killed permanently by Arator Windrunner and Magister Umbric.
Lorisin is a high elf located at the Gilded Oaks in Founder's Point.
Lost Guardian is a mask spirit located in Amani Pass in Eversong Woods.
Luciana Delgado is a human located at the Gala of Gifts by the Stormwind Gate in Elwynn Forest during Love is in the Air.
Loszkeleth is a proto-dragon located in Galakrond's Fall in the Dawn of the Infinite as part of the Blight of Galakrond encounter.
Lucen Swiftmane is a blood elf stable master located in Fairbreeze Village in Eversong Woods.
Lunar Amplification is an Elune's Chosen hero talent for druids.
Lufsela is the current Stormward, leader of the Stormriders, having succeeded Baelgrim in the position. Before becoming the Stormward she was a rooktender.
Luk'gra is an orc located in the Saltfang Shoals in Razorwind Shores.
Lyanna Silverleaf is a night elf located in the Steam Pools in Feralas during Love is in the Air.
Lunation is an Elune's Chosen hero talent for druids. It is an exclusive choice node with Arcane Affinity (druid hero talent).
Lynelle Cremer is a human located in Camp Nowhere in the Azure Span.
Lynne Brightman is a blood elf located at the Brightwing Estate in Eversong Woods. She is sitting on one of the floating platforms with Jon Brightman and Rhett.
Lythianne Morningspear is a blood elf vendor located at the Gala of Gifts in Durotar during Love is in the Air.
Lyrandor Nightveil is a night elf located in the Tranquil Strand in the Isle of Dorn.
Lyssara Duskmourne is a blood elf located in Eversong Woods. She can also be found with Agent Black and Agent Brown at the Seat of Knowledge during the Mind-Seeker secret.
Maddened Proto-Drake is an air-infused proto-dragon located at Sagecrest Pines in the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Mag'tam Wolftamer is an orc located in northern part of the Southfury River in the Northern Barrens. She is surrounded by several pets - Cats, Dogs, Playful Fawn, and Pettable Critters.
Maggie Diamond is a human located in the Steam Pools in Feralas during Love is in the Air.
Magi's Spark is an Arcane mage talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Nether Munitions.

Maggie Wiltshire is a human child located near Newstead in the Arathi Highlands. Players come across her during Trouble in the Highlands, part of the Rise of the Red Dawn storyline. During Faerin Lothar's expedition to the Arathi Highlands, Maggie was attacked by a Red Dawn bandits, only to be found by Faerin, Danath Trollbane, Overlord Geya'rah, and an adventurer. After being calmed by Faerin, she asked the heroes to find her parents.
Magister Sunbreaker is a blood elf magister and a target of Prey hunts.
Magistrix Emberlash is a blood elf mage and a target of Prey hunts.
Magister Kadyn is a blood elf who sometimes represents the Magisters at Saltheril's Haven in Eversong Woods.
Malathra Nighthelm is a night elf located in the Viridescent Thicket in Amirdrassil.

Maklin Drillstab is a Dark Iron dwarf located in the Earthcrawl Mines. He tried to scam Brann Bronzebeard and adventurers into collecting the treasure in the mines for him and then taking it from them.
Malia Pierce is a human located at the Central Encampment in the Emerald Dream.
Malfunctioning Battler is a pounder robot located in the Forbidden Reach.

Manzajin was the leader of the Amani tribe at its founding. He fought against the greed and subjugation of the Zandalari Empire to carve out the borders of a new, free land. The Amani remained stable for centuries despite the Zandalari refusing to recognize the authority of the Amani tribe. Manzajin died by unknown means prior to the Aqir and Troll War around 16,000 BDP.
Marquis Ralerion Dawnbringer is a Darkfallen blood elf who sometimes represents the Shades of the Row at Saltheril's Haven in Eversong Woods.

Marshall Wiltshire is a human located in Newstead in the Arathi Highlands. When the Red Dawn raided the farm, they bound him in a barn, while his daughter escaped with Walker Gresham. When King Danath returned to the Highlands with reinforcements, Maggie asked them to find Marshall. After being rescued, Marshall reunited with his family outside the farm.
Mass Acceleration is an Annihilator hero talent for demon hunters.
Master Sniper Simon McKey is a hero card from the Throne of the Tides set.

Matley Graston is a human located in Goldshire in Elwynn Forest during Love is in the Air. A group of Stormwind Citizens are cheering at him. Players who choose the "challenge" option in The Gift of Self-Care will then be given Loving Yourself, Your Way (Challenge) to engage Matley in a duel.
Matthilde is an earthen located with Konraada and Reingard, on whose back she is resting a book, at the Stoneshaper's Atrium in Dornogal.

Matt Kassan is a former member of Team 2, acting as a community manager. After the release of World of Warcraft, he and Paul Della Bitta pitched the idea of BlizzCon to Blizzard Entertainment executives. The pitch was accepted, and the first BlizzCon was hosted in 2005.
Masterful Call is a Pack Leader hunter hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Slicked Shoes.
Matthew Fernigold is a human located in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands.
Maurice Guichi is a human vendor located at the Gala of Gifts by the Stormwind Gate in Elwynn Forest during Love is in the Air.

Mechanical Bunny is a mechanical rabbit seen on Exile's Reach when the player character is a hunter. It appears as a friendly NPC on the ship during the initial quests up to Brace for Impact (Alliance), then disappears after the shipwreck. It reappears as the "Stalking Prowler" in the Ogre Ruins during Hunting the Stalker (Alliance) and is tamed during The Art of Taming (Alliance).

Mechanical Whelp is a mechanical dragon whelp found in the Apex Observatory, in the Waking Shores. It accompanies Piksin Sparkclamp. It is unclear whether the Mechanical Whelp is a machine created by Piksin or a proto-dragon whelp he augmented.
Meledor is a blood elf mage. He first appeared as Apprentice Meledor in and then as Magister Meledor in .
Mellias Earthtender is a night elf druid located in during Nightmare Incursions.
Meditation Specialization is a druid, mage, paladin, priest, and shaman rune for rings. It is learned from Rune of Meditation Specialization.
Melanie Morten is the human right-hand rider of the . She offers access to mail-services. Killia the auctioneer, can be found on the left side of the mount.
Melandra is a blood elf fishing trainer and vendor located at the Solaarian Sunbath in Eversong Woods.
Menacing Presence is a Scalecommander hero talent for evokers. It is an exclusive choice node with Hardened Scales.
Meraas is a man'ari eredar who attended the Tishamaat in the Trader's Tier in the Exodar. He can be seen speaking with Vindicator Kuros and Vindicator Aesom.
Mercurial Punisher's Painweave is the Tier 28 demon hunter set.

Merrix is the Councilward of Dornogal and the leader of the Council of Dornogal, the ruling body of the earthen of Khaz Algar. Merrix's foremost responsibility is to protect all earthen, as it is the Edict he follows above all others. As the administrator of Dornogal, he is responsible for taking care of his people, organizing workers and allocating resources most efficiently. Merrix holds direct command over the Peacekeepers and the Ordinants. He also has an alternate persona named Steelvein, Dornogal's most notorious smuggler, which he uses to ensure all earthen get the goods they need.
Meritt Herrion was a human who was found at Northshire Valley in Elwynn Forest.
Meteoric Rise is an Annihilator hero talent for demon hunters.
Merissa Firebrew is a hero card from the War of the Elements set.

Mihal is a nerubian warrior of the Sundered Monolith. Along with Ul'Tomon the spiderlord, Mihal served as Brann Bronzebeard's guide during the latter's six-day stay in the Sundered Monolith. Brann had many talks with Mihal, seemingly mostly about the daily life of the warrior caste since he knew little about other subjects like nerubian history or culture.

Mike Booth is a former member of Blizzard Entertainment. Booth was the director of Left 4 Dead and the CEO of Turtle Rock Studios. Booth left Valve for Blizzard Entertainment and came on as a game director for an unannounced project, which was later revealed to be Avalon. Booth left Blizzard in June, 2015, after the project's cancellation.
Militant Rectoress is a blood elf located in Eversong Woods.
Migi is an orc child located behind Grommash Hold in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar.
Mina Stormsmith is a dwarf and was the first wielder of the mace Mithrios, Bronzebeard's Legacy named after her lost brother.
Mindtwister Quimtrix is a hero card from the War of the Elements set.
Mirveda Sunpetal was a blood elf mage, researcher, and scholar of the Magisters. She first appeared as Apprentice Mirveda in Eversong Woods.
Miraculous Recovery is an Oracle hero talent for priests. It is an exclusive choice node with Waste No Time.
Mirrors is a Trickster rogue hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Smoke.
Mistress Nesala is a hero card from the Tomb of the Forgotten set.
Mist Dispersion is a Mistweaver monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Veil of Pride.
Mithrios Stormsmith is a lost dwarf brother of Mina Stormsmith. The mace Mithrios would be named him.
Mogra is an orc child located behind Grommash Hold in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar.
Mok'drul is a monster ally card from the Tomb of the Forgotten set.
Mongoose Rounds is a Survival hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Wildfire Shells.
Mor'duun was the leader of the Twilight's Blade and an ally of Xal'atath.

Moratari is an infinite dragon located in Timeless Shore on Timeless Isle. She is educating Infinite Riftmenders, Infinite Scholars, and Infinite Acolytes. She is also seen in Paw'don Village and Honeydew Village in the Jade Forest as well as at Infinite Bazaars. Later, she appeared in Dalaran.
Morkus Grimlock is an ogre mage planned to appear in the Arathi Highlands during the Plunderstorm.
Morta Gage is a Kul Tiran human located in the Arcantina. She sells housing decor from the Old Soldiers and New Friends quests.
Mordril Shadowfell is a void elf and a target of Prey hunts.
N'ora Anyheart is a night elf scholar located in Ratchet in the . She will speak to crafters who bring her the Handful of Shifting Scales.
Nadia Brighton is a human located in the Voidstorm. She is an officer within the Vanguard of the Light.
Narrowed Visions is an Oracle hero talent for priests. It is an exclusive choice node with Fatebender.
Naremdil Gladewalker is a night elf. He would reuse Mathrengyl Bearwalker's model.
Nara Fadebranch is a blood elf located in Goldenmist Village in Eversong Woods.
Nancy Songflower is a human herbalism trainer located in Northshire Valley in .
Nature Harmony is a Farseer hero talent for shaman. It is an exclusive choice node with Earthen Communion.
Nature's Protection is a Stormbringer hero talent for shaman. It is an exclusive choice node with Surging Currents.
Nature Specialization is a druid, hunter, rogue, and shaman rune for rings. It is learned from Rune of Nature Specialization.

Natalia Pearce is a human initially located outside Freywold Village on the Isle of Dorn. She is an expert on gems, but when Dalaran crashed, she lost all her gems, books, and scrolls. Now, she wanted to obtain gem knowledge from Basalteous. She tried talking to the earthen in the village but did not tell her anything, so she asked an adventurer to try speaking with them again, and they succeeded. Imagining how rich she would be, Natalia quickly headed out to Basalteous's cave on the coast. Inside, Natalia found Standing Stones and gems. She wanted to activate the stones to lure out Basalteous and knew from the earthen that she needed elemental cores, so she had the adventurer obtain them fr
Necrolyte Teachings is a Soul Harvester warlock hero talent.
Nedward is a bronze dragon in human visage form located in the Infinite Bazaar in Legion: Remix. He runs a barbershop named Fanciful Fashions.

Apprentice Nelphi is a human found patrolling Dalaran from Krasus' Landing to the Silver Enclave to the Magus Commerce Exchange to the Legerdemain Lounge. Near the end of the war against the Lich King, Nelphi sent champions of the Alliance to meet her patron, Jaina Proudmoore, inside the Forge of Souls, the first of the Frozen Halls instances in Icecrown Citadel. Nelphi also appears in Violet Rise on the Isle of Thunder near Jaina. During a break in the trial of Garrosh Hellscream, Jaina and Kalec went for a walk in Violet Rise. Jaina told Nelphi they would be gone for a little while, but not to delay supper if everyone else was ready. She was described as an eager young apprentice who helpe
Needleback is a dragon turtle located in the Krasarang Wilds.
Negentropist Voidtear is a void elf vendor located in Shan'dorah in K'aresh.
Neishura is a void elf located in Windrunner Village in Eversong Woods.
Neferset Bladelord is a monster ally card from the Tomb of the Forgotten set.
Neferset Flamecaller is a monster ally card from the Tomb of the Forgotten set.
Neferset Frostbringer is a monster ally card from the Tomb of the Forgotten set.
Neferset Runecaster is a monster ally card from the Tomb of the Forgotten set.
Neferset Scorpid Keeper is a monster ally card from the Tomb of the Forgotten set.
Neferset Shadowlancer is a monster ally card from the Tomb of the Forgotten set.
Neferset Shadowstalker is a monster ally card from the Tomb of the Forgotten set.
Neferset Shieldguard is a monster ally card from the Tomb of the Forgotten set.
Nerene Brooksinger is a night elf druid located in during Nightmare Incursions.
Nether Munitions is an Arcane mage talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Magi's Spark.
Neriv is a blood elf located at Saltheril's Haven in Eversong Woods. She is the renown quartermaster for the Shades of the Row faction, offering rewards in exchange for Brimming Arcana.
Nielia Whispersong is a night elf found sleeping in the Eye of Ysera and Slumbersome Shores in the Emerald Dream.
Newly Turned is a San'layn hero talent for death knights. It is an exclusive choice node with Vampiric Speed.
Nexus-Princess Ky'veza is a void ethereal nexus-princess. She serves as a boss in Nerub-ar Palace, the nemesis of season 3 of delves, and a reluctant ally within Manaforge Omega.
Night Elf Arcanist is an ally card depicting a Night elf arcanist from the Betrayal of the Guardian set.
Niels is a human located at the Outer Banks on the western end of Founder's Point.
Nexus-Thief Asar is a hero card from the Tomb of the Forgotten set.
Nexus-Edge Hadim is a void ethereal assassin and a target of Prey hunts.
Night Elf Ranger is an ally card depicting a night elf ranger from the Betrayal of the Guardian set.
Night Elf Swiftblade is an ally card depicting a night elf rogue from the Betrayal of the Guardian set.
Nils Stonebrow was a dwarf found at the Ironforge Visitor's Center in Ironforge.
No Scruples is a Trickster rogue hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Cloud Cover.
Niuzao's Protection is a Conduit of the Celestials monk hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Jade Sanctuary.
Noblegarden Celebrant is a human located in Goldshire in Elwynn Forest. She is followed by a Hungry Duck.
No Place Like Home is a human racial trait that modifies the Hearthstone by reducing the cooldown by 5 minutes and provides an additional charge.
Nordun Steadysight is a dwarf vendor located in Goldshire in Elwynn Forest.
Numi is a human found in Everlook in . After completing Poacher's Den, she will provide Warmed Rumsey Rum with Cream once every few days.
Numia Golden is a blood elf located in Goldenmist Village in Eversong Woods. She is healing Hathvelion Sungaze, who was wounded by a snapdragon.
Obsidian Arrowhead is a Marksmanship hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with On Target.
Odrinn Bronzekeel is a dwarf of Keg Leg's Crew located in Brew Bay in the Arathi Highlands during Plunderstorm. He can be found begging in front of a pile of treasure.

Oe is the Loa of Growth, also called the lord of trees. They are among the least known of the Amani gods. As far as Amani historians know, Oe acted as an unseen and unknown protector of the ancient Amani as they pursued the C'Thraxxi general Kith'ix to the land now known as Zul'Aman. Oe is worshiped not at shrines or altars, but at the sites of large pine trees. It is believed that the trees grow large by feeding on the spirit of growth—but that if a tree is too greedy and takes in too much spirit, it will come alive and rampage in madness.
Olafus is a human located at the Outer Banks in Founder's Point.
On Target is a Marksmanship hunter talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Obsidian Arrowhead.

Olias Rivershaw is a human located next to an Uncharged Focus in the Upper Frostlands in the Azure Span. Three crystals are found in the ruined tower just north of his location: A Chiming Fragment, a Humming Fragment and a Singing Fragment. The focus can be stabilized with the Singing Fragment, after which Trilvarus Loreweaver will appear in order to stop the mage.
Olivia Demascas is a hero card from the War of the Elements set.

Onyxia Sigils is a currency players can collect in Warcraft Rumble as they progress through the single-player campaign. It is meant to show how far the player is in the campaign and unlocks features as the player obtains more. Zones unlock at certain intervals of sigils owned. For example, to start fighting the bosses in Duskwood, a player would need to have 10 sigils to unlock the zone. The bosses inside the zone will also need additional sigils, with the first boss requiring only 10 and increasing by one for each boss after up to 15 for the final boss . Bosses in zones after the Stranglethorn Vale zone only require the same amount of sigils needed to unlock the zone. For example, Blackrock
One Tusk is a tuskarr member of the Algari Expedition located in Fungal Folly.
Onyx Clutchwarden is a black drakonid who is defending black dragon eggs from Primalist attack in the Ruby Life Pools.
Open Fire is a Sentinel hunter hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Stargazer.
Orc Blackblade is an ally card depicting an orc rogue from the Betrayal of the Guardian set.
Orc Flamecaller is an ally card depicting an orc pyromancer from the Betrayal of the Guardian set.
Orgon Warpchain is an orc found sitting in the Sapphire Enclave in Valdrakken during Who Are You?.
Orelle Dawndrift is a void elf general goods vendor located in the Howling Ridge in the Voidstorm.

Orweyna is the leader of the group of haranir scouts in Azj-Kahet, where she works to protect the great roots by containing the spread of Black Blood. Fascinated by the mortal races, she shares their concerns about the threat posed by the Kaheti and is willing to aid and work with adventurers, even if it means violating the oaths that forbid her people from interacting with strangers. She has some kind of significant connection to the Radiant Song. She can, with ease, "pick up on the harmony of this world" to restore her mind to reality if she becomes shifted into the Unseeming.

Otharia is a green dragon in night elf visage who was captured by the Zaqali djaradin in the Emerald Dream and brought to Igira at the Slagfell Hold. She and Akuda can be then seen at the Wellspring of Life during the quests The Age of Mortals and Echo of the Firelands. They are unable to be rescued however, and they disappear after the completion of Echo of the Firelands.
Otherworldly Focus is an Annihilator hero talent for demon hunters.
Overflowing Potential was a druid hero talent that was announced at BlizzCon 2023. It shared a choice node with Bounteous Bloom.
Finishing Blows is an Arms warrior talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Mass Execution.
Overlord Mechagon is the leader of the Mechagon mechagnomes in A.Z.E.R.O.T.H. His appearance is manifested and used by the Fractured Causality during Time Rifts.

Overseer Roskarrag is an earthen character in "Forget Me Not", a play performed by the theater troupe at the Proscenium on the Isle of Dorn. She didn't approve of Brunelda and Clodgran's love as she believed it reduced their efficiency in their work and so attempted to erase Brunelda's memories to eliminate the "love virus" and maintain productivity. However ultimately Roskarrag was defeated by Clodgran when she attacked the couple after he successfully restored Brunelda's memories.
Overflowing Purse is a Fatebound rogue hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Destiny Defined.
Pack's Endurance is a Druid of the Claw hero talent for druids.
Overwhelming Force is a Master of Harmony hero talent for monks.
Oversurge is a Totemic shaman hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Amplification Core.
Oversized Totems is a Totemic hero talent for shaman. It is an exclusive choice node with Swift Recall.
Painful Death is a Deathbringer hero talent for death knights. It is an exclusive choice node with Swift End.
Pageturner Metros is an infinite dragon in gnome visage form located in the Infinite Bazaar in Legion: Remix.
Paige is a human located in the kitchen of the Dalaran Orphanage in Dalaran in the .
Par'kourc is an orc found at Stonewatch Keep in the . He can only be encountered while wearing the disguise of the Linkue Combatant Icon.
Partek Redwing is a blood elf located at the Solaarian Sunbath in Eversong Woods.
Patreux is a nightborne mage member of the Algari Expedition located in Fungal Folly where she was trying to hone her combat skills.
Pathius Dawnglow is a blood elf located near Tranquillien in Eversong Woods.

Paul Della Bitta is a former member of Team 2, acting as a community manager. After the release of World of Warcraft, he and Matt Kassan pitched the idea of BlizzCon to Blizzard Entertainment executives. The pitch was accepted, and the first BlizzCon was hosted in 2005.
Pearl Barlow is a human decor specialist located at Tradewinds Market in Boralus.
Peer Into Peace is a Mistweaver monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Pool of Mists.
Perfect Vision is an Oracle hero talent for priests. It is an exclusive choice node with Fatebender.
Perfecto is a human located at the Forgegrounds in Dornogal.

Perry is a human found in Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands. He and his brothers had been serving the Syndicate as bandits for years. During the unrest in the Highlands, the new Syndicate leader sent the Olsons on a mission for the Red Dawn, which Barclay attributed to the leader's attempt to get rid of them. They could choose from two assignments: either infiltrate Hammerfall or plant evidence in Witherbark Village and frame the Horde. They chose the latter, but the mission went awry; the brothers, except Barclay, were captured by the Witherbark trolls, while Barclay managed to escape and negotiate help. Adventurers entered the village and found Perry strapped to an altar and being bound
Phantasmal Priestess is a night elf ghost located in Blackfathom Deeps.
Phantom Pain is a Dark Ranger hunter hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Ebon Bowstring.
Petra is a human located outside the Caverns of Time in Tanaris. A Pet Box containing a Pet Mirror is found next to her.
Pincushion is a pandaren member of Keg Leg's Crew located in Brew Bay in the Arathi Highlands during Plunderstorm. Pincushion is being chased by Nozand.
Plague Mastery is an Unholy death knight talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Grave Mastery.
Poggchug Ragethrower is an orc located in Durotar, being cheered at by Razor Hill Citizens.
Pole Weapon Specialization is a druid, hunter, rogue, shaman, and warrior rune for rings. It is learned from Rune of Pole Weapon Specialization.
Pollero Rene is a human located at the Path of Renewal in Dalaran in the .
Potent Enchantments is a Keeper of the Grove druid hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Grove's Inspiration.
Predictive Training is a Shado-Pan hero talent for monks. It is an exclusive choice node with Whirling Steel.
Priestess Therdre is a night elf located in Bel'ameth in Amirdrassil. She can display all the cutscenes from the events after the blooming of Amirdrassil.

Commander Primwell Skye was a mage and a military theorist who also served as archivist in the Old Monastery before the Second War. She bolstered her kingdom's strategy during the conflict, serving as tactician on the Arathi front. She then retired to a farmstead there and eventually died. Her staff was eventually retrieved and found its way back to the Scarlet Monastery, while her farm was taken over by the Horde.
Prompt Deliverance is an Oracle hero talent for priests. It is an exclusive choice node with Divine Feathers.
Professor Boomspark is a human located at the Demolition Dome in the Liberation of Undermine. He is Torq's manager.
Prophet's Will is an Oracle priest hero talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Desperate Measures.
Pulse Capacitor is a Totemic hero talent for shaman. It is an exclusive choice node with Supportive Imbuements.
Puk is an orc child located behind Grommash Hold in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar.
Pureblooded Proto-Drake is a proto-dragon from Ulderoth located in Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus during Time Rifts.
Purified Spirit is a Master of Harmony hero talent for monks. It is an exclusive choice node with Harmonic Gambit.
Pyromastery is a Fire mage talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Mark of the Firelord.
Pygmy Pyramid is a monster ally card from the Tomb of the Forgotten set.

Quartermaster Kyleen is a night elf quartermaster for the Emerald Wardens found south of the portal in .
Quartermaster Valdane is a night elf quartermaster for the Emerald Wardens found north of the Twin Colossals in .
Queen Rickiticka is the queen of the undercrawlers located in the Chittering Den in the Ringing Deeps.
Quickflame is a Fire mage talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Flame Patch.

Rabaan is an earthen theater troupe member located in the Proscenium in the Isle of Dorn. He plays General Ottomar in "The Rivals" play and serves as a narrator in the "Forget Me Not" and "The Thraegar's Descent" plays.
Radical Straz is a human riding a shark of Keg Leg's Crew located in Brew Bay in the Arathi Highlands during Plunderstorm.
Ragespike is a monster ally card from the Tomb of the Forgotten set.
Rahgi Sourbone is an orc located at the Common in Razorwind Shores. She makes hearty meat pies with crunchy bread that Arnold Guyvere sells.
Ranger Allorn is a blood elf located at Saltheril's Haven in Eversong Woods. He is the renown quartermaster for the Farstriders faction, offering rewards in exchange for Brimming Arcana.
Ranath Nightstride is a night elf located in the Linguists Lounge in Dalaran in the .

Rashan Stillbrook is a night elf located in the Barrows of Reverie and Fields of Reverie in Amirdrassil. When he overheard Kelestra speaking about her sister, Koroleth, he was bitter and was against burying the remains of Koroleth inside the barrow den, as she had killed his brother. He went to Malfurion Stormrage and tried to convince him not to allow it.
Ranger Swiftglade is a blood elf farstrider and a target of Prey hunts.
Ranger Vardis is a blood elf located at the West Sanctum in Eversong Woods.
Ravensmith Ta'lir is a night elf located in Bel'ameth in Amirdrassil. He is working on a ballista.

Razik Chumpchanger is a goblin general goods vendor summoned by the Goblin Town-in-a-Box along with a box of fireworks behind him. He has the buff which lasts for 20 minutes, afterwards he'll despawn.
Reaper's Mark is a Deathbringer hero talent for death knights.
Reaver's Mark is an Aldrachi Reaver demon hunter hero talent.

Recalled Lord Jaraxxus is a man'ari eredar projection summoned by Recalled Wilfred Fizzlebang near the Wrathgate in the Dragonblight during the Radiant Echoes event. During the fight, he summons Recalled Mistresses of Pain. He is the memory of Lord Jaraxxus.
Reaper's Onslaught is a Deathbringer hero talent for death knights. It is an exclusive choice node with Dark Talons (death knight hero talent).
Refreshment is a Mistweaver monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Calming Coalescence.
Relaeron is a night elf located at the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. He will give the Rune of Carve to hunters who bring him a tamed Deer.
Remembered Timberlain is a human projection located east of Pyrox Flats in the Searing Gorge during the Radiant Echoes event. She is the memory of Sara Timberlain.
Remembered Maybell is a human projection located east of Pyrox Flats in the Searing Gorge during the Radiant Echoes event. She is the memory of Maybell Maclure.
Remembered Remy is a human projection located east of Pyrox Flats in the Searing Gorge during the Radiant Echoes event. He is the memory of Remy "Two Times".
Remembered Beaten Corpse is an orc projection located in the Quagmire in Dustwallow Marsh during Radiant Echoes. She is the memory of the Beaten Corpse.
Renegade Swabbie is a human serving as the first Rank 7 match in the Brawler's Guild during who has somehow snuck away from the Plunderstorm.

Render Behemoth was a crypt lord located in the Dread Wastes. With just under 400m health, it was assumed to be intended as a world boss, likely with the model being a placeholder for that of a Kunchong.
Researcher Onermu is a bronze dragon found in the Foundation Hall in Dornogal.
Researcher Essarae is a void elf located in Shan'dorah in K'aresh.
Reshanor is a void dragon world boss located at Lunnall River in K'aresh. Players are tasked with defeating it in the world quest Reshanor, the Untethered.
Resilient Flourishing is a Wildstalker hero talent for druids. It is an exclusive choice node with Root Network.
Revolving Whirl is a Windwalker monk talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Echo Technique.
Rider's Champion is a Rider of the Apocalypse death knight hero talent.
Riftwalker Tailos is a void elf located in Fathom's Edge on Telogrus Rift. He can be seen speaking with Riftwalker Dellyn. When the Shadowguard attacked, he helped defend the area.
